comments.author: Gudebuddha
comments.body:
7* Shipwreck "Ghost Ship"

Chest:
Salvager Jacket
Jet Black Short Sword
Seal of Sylph x49
White Alchemy Ointment x71

and some trade goods (Silver, Agate)

4 Enemys: "Ghost Sailor" 31,23,23,19

Lots of "Lost Sailor" ghost that gave some adventure xp (60-90), some ducats (around 100-150k each) or stuff like: Danu's Prayer, Seal of Undine, Stomach Medicine

After a while the "Lost Sailor" stoped spawning.

A couple of times i got the message that Marching avoided me taking damage. Dont know how much damage that would have been.

comments.author: Scara
comments.body:
if your Marching is too low (Idk how low), the wreck crumble down, you have a white screen then back to dock. With high Marching, the wreck resist and you have time to talk to all "lost sailor".
After a certain time you have a blue message saying, no more soul in this wreck, you can leave when you want.
